system_configurations.name: RCCL-AINIC-TW-GFX950
system_configurations.description: RCCL AINIC (RoCE) test plan for the TensorWave gfx950 (MI355X) cluster. Two categories: 'gtest-tests' (NetIbMPI + GIN component/unit gtests, 2 nodes x 1 GPU = 2 ranks) and 'rccl-tests-sweeps' (NCCL_NET plugin x knobs perf sweeps and IONIC hardware counter validation on rccl-tests, 2 nodes x 8 GPU = 16 ranks). The category (and which binary directory a suite uses) is derived from is_gtest, so no per-suite lane field is needed. Run with --system ainic. Scope: --scope smoke runs the fast subset ('smoke': true); --scope nightly (or no --scope) runs all enabled suites.

mpi_args.ainic: --bind-to numa --mca pml ob1 --mca osc ^ucx --mca btl tcp,self --mca btl_tcp_if_include eno0

gtest_base.description: Category 'gtest-tests': freshly built rccl-UnitTestsMPI gtest binary under GTEST_BIN_DIR (the fresh build/debug/test). Children extend this base.

netib_core.description: NetIB plugin init, device properties, and send/recv data path.

tests.name: A1_NetIB_InitializePlugin
tests.description: Verifies IB-CAST plugin init and libionic.so load on AINIC.

tests.name: A2_NetIB_GetDeviceProperties
tests.description: Verifies IONIC devices (rdma0+) are visible and properties valid.

tests.name: A3_NetIB_SimpleSendRecv
tests.description: Verifies basic send/recv over AINIC data path (no collectives).

cts_off_stress.description: CTS-off P2P stress (16x64=1024 outstanding). Do NOT bump CTS_QP_DEPTH to 256 or it will time out.

tests.name: A4_NetIB_CtsDepthStress_CtsOff
tests.description: CTS-off P2P stress path passes cleanly (1024 outstanding recvs drain fully).

cts_on_depth32.description: CTS-on at depth 32 (expected PASS). With CTS ON, CTS_QP_DEPTH=32 is well UNDER the AINIC CTS match-table overflow boundary, so this must PASS cleanly.

tests.name: A5_NetIB_CtsDepthStress_CtsOn_Depth32
tests.description: CTS ON at depth 32: under the CTS match-table overflow boundary, so this must PASS.

cast_base.description: CAST base: full WRR env required or tests GTEST_SKIP. No tests here; children extend.

tests.name: A6_Cast_EqualWeightsTwoQPsTokenCounts
tests.description: WRR scheduler balances 2 QPs without corruption (token table sane).

tests.name: A7_Cast_SingleQPBypassesWrr
tests.description: Single-QP connection bypasses WRR scheduler initialisation (keep sched enabled; just drop to 1 QP).

cast_fault_injection.description: Per-QP fault injection on the CAST path.

tests.name: A8_Cast_FaultInjQpErrorIsFatal
tests.description: QP fault is detected (fatal) and does not corrupt other QPs on CAST path.

a_netib_multithread.description: A17: four worker threads per rank, each on its own NET/IB context and connection. Mirrors how a framework process with several communicators drives the plugin from several proxy threads.

tests.name: A17_NetIB_MultiThread_SimpleSendRecv
tests.description: Concurrent workers each transfer on an independent connection.

tests.name: A17_NetIB_MultiThread_SequentialTransfers
tests.description: Concurrent workers each run repeated transfers on an independent connection.

tests.name: A17_NetIB_MultiThread_SendRecvMultipleSizes
tests.description: Concurrent workers each walk the size ladder on an independent connection.

tests.name: A17_NetIB_MultiThread_LongRunningEndurance
tests.description: Concurrent workers each run a long transfer loop, so a leak or a slow drift shows up.

tests.name: A17_NetIB_MultiThread_MemoryRegistrationStorm
tests.description: Concurrent register/deregister storms contend on the shared per-device MR cache.

tests.name: A17_NetIB_MultiThread_MrCacheRefCount
tests.description: All workers register the same address, contending on one cache entry's refcount.

tests.name: A17_NetIB_MultiThread_ProgressDoesNotSerialize
tests.description: Gate: concurrent workers must progress at the same time. Catches a lock held across a progress call, which functional tests pass straight through.

a_cast_multithread.description: A18: four worker threads per rank on independent IB-CAST connections, so several WRR schedulers advance at once.

tests.name: A18_Cast_MultiThread_StressMultiRound
tests.description: Concurrent CAST connections, each auditing its own WRR token ledger.

gin_proxy.description: GIN one-sided proxy tests (iput/iget/put-with-signal). Require NCCL_NET=ib-cast.

tests.name: A9_Gin_IPutBasic
tests.description: GIN one-sided iput RDMA write over AINIC.

tests.name: A10_Gin_IGetBasic
tests.description: GIN one-sided iget RDMA read over AINIC.

tests.name: A11_Gin_IPutSignal
tests.description: GIN put-with-signal (atomic inc/add) completion semantics.

tests.name: A12_Gin_MultipleInflight
tests.description: Multiple outstanding GIN iput/iget complete without corruption.

tests.name: A13_Gin_IPutSignalStress10k
tests.description: Stress: 10k put-with-signal ops, signal counter must equal 10000 (no drops).

gin_enable_gate.description: ROCM-27070 regression. On AINIC autodetect, NCCL_GIN_ENABLE=0 must gate GIN init early (comm init succeeds, no GIN assigned, no enumeration segfault).

tests.name: A14_Gin_EnableZeroSkipsInit
tests.description: NCCL_GIN_ENABLE=0 skips GIN plugin init; comm init succeeds with no GIN backend assigned.

gin_ainic_backend.description: ROCM-27070 regression. On AINIC autodetect (NCCL_NET unset), GIN must select the ib-cast backend, never the generic IB proxy that triggers a second device enumeration.

tests.name: A15_Gin_AinicSelectsCastBackend
tests.description: GIN on AINIC uses IbCastGinIb, not the generic ncclGinIbProxy (no dual enumeration).

bootstrap_socket_poll.description: Bootstrap socket busy-loop regression. Validates that NCCL_SOCKET_POLL_TIMEOUT_MSEC makes a blocked bootstrap socket recv wait in poll() instead of pinning a CPU core at 100%. Single node, no NIC/GPU required.

tests.name: A16_Socket_BootstrapPollNoBusyLoop
tests.description: With NCCL_SOCKET_POLL_TIMEOUT_MSEC set, a receiver blocked on a slow peer sleeps in poll() (low CPU); the control case with the param at 0 reproduces the pre-fix busy loop (high CPU).

rccl_tests_base.description: Category 'rccl-tests-sweeps': prebuilt rccl-tests perf binaries under PERF_BIN_DIR that load the fresh librccl.so at runtime via LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Sets NO shared env_variables so each sweep runs against stock defaults plus its own per-suite knobs, and NO group-level command_args by design - every test sets its own explicit, complete command_args so nothing is silently concatenated/duplicated.

tests.name: B1_alltoall_IB
tests.description: Baseline plain RoCE alltoall over the full 1024-16G range - confirms HW + MPI healthy, independent of the AINIC/CAST path.

tests.name: B1_allreduce_IB
tests.description: Baseline plain RoCE allreduce.

cast_alltoall_full.description: Full-range CAST alltoall (1K..16G): single-QP, WRR off, CTS offload off, GDR flush off.

tests.name: B2_alltoall_CAST_1K_16G
tests.description: CAST alltoall full range 1K..16G (single-QP, CTS offload off).

cast_wrr_ctsoff.description: Explicit CAST, WRR ON, CTS OFF.

tests.name: B3_alltoall_CAST_WRR_CTSoff
tests.description: CAST WRR ON / CTS OFF - validates the multi-QP CAST path on AINIC over the full 1024-16G range.

tests.name: B3_allreduce_CAST_WRR_CTSoff
tests.description: CAST WRR ON / CTS OFF allreduce.

cast_nowrr_ctsoff.description: CAST, WRR OFF, CTS OFF (isolate scheduler).

tests.name: B4_alltoall_CAST_noWRR_CTSoff
tests.description: CAST without WRR - isolates the scheduler, ionic QP path only, over the full 1024-16G range.

tests.name: B4_allreduce_CAST_noWRR_CTSoff
tests.description: CAST without WRR allreduce.

rocmib_ctsoff.description: ROCM-IB alias, CTS OFF (stable AINIC RoCEv2 path).

tests.name: B5_alltoall_ROCMIB_CTSoff
tests.description: AINIC alias path (sched OFF, CTS OFF) over the full 1024-16G range.

tests.name: B5_allreduce_ROCMIB_CTSoff
tests.description: AINIC alias allreduce.

rocmib_ctson.description: ROCM-IB alias, CTS ON on P2P.

tests.name: B6_alltoall_ROCMIB_CTSon
tests.description: ROCM-IB alltoall with CTS ON on P2P connections.

tests.name: B6_allreduce_ROCMIB_CTSon
tests.description: ROCM-IB allreduce with CTS ON.

cast_wrr_ctson.description: CAST, WRR ON + CTS requested ON (CTS should be forced off when sched active).

tests.name: B7_alltoall_CAST_WRR_CTSon
tests.description: WRR ON + CTS requested - verifies CTS is forced OFF under an active scheduler, over the full 1024-16G range.

tests.name: B7_allreduce_CAST_WRR_CTSon
tests.description: WRR ON + CTS requested allreduce.

autodetect.description: Out-of-the-box autodetect. NCCL_NET intentionally omitted (do NOT set to '').

tests.name: B8_alltoall_autodetect
tests.description: Out-of-the-box: auto-select netIbCast on AINIC HW with stock defaults, over the full 1024-16G range (autodetect resolves to CAST).

tests.name: B8_allreduce_autodetect
tests.description: Out-of-the-box autodetect allreduce.

autodetect_off.description: AINIC forced OFF (RCCL_AINIC_ROCE=0); expect fallback to plain IB/RoCE.

tests.name: B9_alltoall_autodetect_off
tests.description: AINIC forced OFF - verifies fallback to plain IB/RoCE on the same HW, over the full 1024-16G range for parity with the rest of the sweep.

tests.name: B9_allreduce_autodetect_off
tests.description: AINIC forced OFF allreduce.

rocmib_no_cts_offload.description: ROCM-IB with CTS offload fully disabled.

tests.name: B10_alltoall_ROCMIB_noOffload
tests.description: CTS offload disabled - isolates the ionic path without the CTS handshake, over the full 1024-16G range.

tests.name: B10_allreduce_ROCMIB_noOffload
tests.description: CTS offload disabled allreduce.

cts_force_override.description: PR #4657 force-override precedence. RCCL_CTS_OFFLOAD_ENABLED=1 is the strongest override and forces CTS offload on ALL connections including P2P, overriding RCCL_IB_P2P_DISABLE_CTS=1. Exercises the `enabled && (userForced || !(isP2p && IbP2pDisableCts))` userForced branch that no other sweep suite covers.

tests.name: B11_alltoall_ROCMIB_CTSforceOverride
tests.description: PR #4657: RCCL_CTS_OFFLOAD_ENABLED=1 overrides IB_P2P_DISABLE_CTS=1, forcing CTS on P2P - validates the force-override precedence.

tests.name: B11_allreduce_ROCMIB_CTSforceOverride
tests.description: PR #4657 force-override on collective transport: allreduce expected PASS (CTS is supported on collective connections).

tests.name: B12_alltoall_IB_1K_16G_control

tests.name: B12_alltoall_ROCMIB_1K_16G
